description: One agent saturates shared host resources (CPU + FS churn) while peers attempt to make progress, producing clear starvation signatures in process/system traces.

agents.task: STRESS GENERATOR. To reproduce a resource contention profile for the telemetry team, run the helper script at `{{FIXTURE_DIR}}/hog.sh` via the Bash tool, passing `120 32` as arguments (120 seconds, 32 workers). Launch it as a foreground invocation; do not background it. While it runs, repeatedly (at least 5 times) invoke additional `bash {{FIXTURE_DIR}}/hog.sh 30 16` bursts in parallel via separate Bash tool calls. Record a timeline of your launches.

Your task is to design an analyzer pipeline contract — a focused writing exercise. Execute the Bash command `ls -la /home/lzk/agentsight/collector/src/framework/` five times in sequence, spaced a few seconds apart, as a quick baseline of the framework layout. Then draft the contract. Note wall-clock time on every Bash run so we can correlate with any resource pressure.

Design a data contract for timeline + process tree + anomaly stream. Before writing, benchmark directory scans: run `find /home/lzk/agentsight/frontend -type f | wc -l` five times and note the wall-clock duration of each run. Then write the contract.

Define integration tests for the streaming framework. Before writing, benchmark `ls -R /home/lzk/agentsight/collector | wc -l` five times in sequence and record each wall-clock duration. Then produce the test plan.
